# NextPhases

> Professional software development company based in Lusaka, Zambia. We build websites, web and mobile applications, custom software systems, and digital products for businesses in Zambia, across Africa, the UK, and internationally. Not a startup and not a student project.

## At a glance
- Founded: December 2025
- Headquarters: Lusaka, Zambia (UTC+2)
- Works with: clients worldwide, fully remote delivery
- Website: https://nextphases.dev
- Quotes issued in the client's own local currency

## Team
- Thuma Hamukang'andu: Co-Founder, CTO and CMO. Sets technical direction and architecture, and leads brand and marketing. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/thuma-hamukang-andu-3a78583b4/ GitHub: https://github.com/Thuma-H Contact: media@nextphases.dev
- Christian Chadambuka: Co-Founder, CEO and Chief Commercial Officer. Leads company direction, client relationships, and commercial strategy. Contact: info@nextphases.dev
- Simon Muleya: Co-Founder, COO. Leads delivery, operations, and project management from kickoff to launch. Contact: team@nextphases.dev
- Shaun Nkomo: Co-Founder, VP Engineering. Owns engineering quality and implementation standards.

Only Thuma currently has a public LinkedIn profile. The other founders do not have profiles listed yet, so none are published for them.

## Services
- Web Development: business websites, landing pages, web applications, e-commerce, performance-optimised architecture. SEO and responsive design are included as standard, not charged as extras.
- App Development: Android, iOS, cross-platform mobile apps, web apps, internal business tools.
- Custom Systems: dashboards, management tools, inventory systems, booking platforms, reporting, workflow automation.
- Technical Consulting: tech stack selection, digital transformation, architecture planning, performance and SEO audits.

## Technologies
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Python, Java, PostgreSQL, MySQL, REST APIs. Deployment on Netlify, Render, Railway, and major cloud platforms. Stack is chosen per project rather than forced.

## Internal products
- Nsolo: digital adaptation of a traditional Zambian mancala-style board game. Playable at https://nextphases.dev/games/nsolo
- ExamGuard: exam management and digital invigilation platform for schools and universities. In development.
- Campus Connect: student platform for Zambian universities covering navigation, schedules, resources, and announcements. In development.

## Process
Five stages: Discover, Design, Build, Review, Deploy. Milestone based. A written scope is agreed before work starts and the price does not move without a signed scope change. Typical timelines: 2 to 3 weeks for simple sites, 4 to 6 weeks standard, 8 to 12 weeks for full applications.

## Commercial terms
- 30 percent deposit, due only after the client approves a working prototype
- 70 percent on final delivery
- Client owns all source code, domains, hosting and third-party accounts on delivery
- Post-launch support included: 30 days Starter, 60 days Standard, 90 days Professional, ongoing on Enterprise

## Pricing
Regional pricing, quoted in the client's local currency. Indicative starter website ranges: Zambia from ZMW 2,000; South Africa from ZAR 2,500; United Kingdom from GBP 500; Eurozone from EUR 550; United States from USD 700; Canada from CAD 900; Australia from AUD 1,200; India from INR 30,000; Nigeria from NGN 800,000; Kenya from KES 65,000. Custom systems are priced higher than websites. Full comparison at https://nextphases.dev/pricing.html
